name: jl-graph
description: Structured queries over the cowork markdown corpus (search_docs, list_active, project_state, decisions, who, audit).
long_description: Bridges Claude Desktop, Cowork sessions, and live artifacts to the locally-hosted cowork-graph MCP server via a thin stdio-to-HTTP proxy (mcp-remote) pointing at http://127.0.0.1:8765/mcp (the cowork-graph-mcp.service systemd user unit in WSL). RENAMED from 'cowork-graph' (2026-07-31): Claude Desktop reserves the 'cowork' name prefix for its internal servers and LocalMcpServerManager silently drops colliding extensions before they reach the remote-devices bridge — which is why this extension never surfaced to cloud Cowork sessions despite working in the desktop app. The tool prefix live artifacts see is now mcp__jl-graph__*; artifacts that hardcoded mcp__cowork-graph__* must be updated. NOTE: mcp_config uses an ABSOLUTE path instead of ${__dirname} because the artifact-host connect path does not substitute manifest variables ('Node.js server requires a resolvable entry point' error, 2026-07-13). The path assumes install under %APPDATA%/Claude/Claude Extensions/local.mcpb.joe-laskowski.jl-graph/.
